text:
anna: FYI — customer on prod (acct acme-42) sees bursts of 503s and duplicate charges during a retry storm. Repro attached.
sam: can you paste logs and SDK version?
anna: python-sdk 1.4.2, urllib3 1.26.16, running in uWSGI with gevent monkeypatch. Logs:
anna: ```
2026-02-12T14:02:31Z WARN retrying request status=503 idempotency-key=abcd... missing_on_retry=false
2026-02-12T14:02:31Z INFO sending request idempotency-key=abcd...
2026-02-12T14:02:31Z WARN received 503, scheduling retry backoff_ms=1200 jitter_seed=0x9f3a
2026-02-12T14:02:32Z INFO retrying request idempotency-key= <MISSING> status=retry
```
sam: interesting — idempotency header present on initial request but missing when retried. any custom session or adapter?
jess: repro script (short):
```python
import requests
from redwood import RedwoodClient

c = RedwoodClient(api_key='x', session=requests.Session())

# run in multiprocess/uwsgi worker with gevent
for _ in range(100):
    c.generate(..., idempotency_key='key-1')
```
eli: I can reproduce w/ uWSGI + gevent + concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor. Looks like RNG reseed happens when worker forks and threadpool restarts -> jitter deterministic and idemp header mutated by our retry wrapper.
sam: can you capture headers around retry?
jess: added debug output, see snippet:
```text
-> POST /v1/generate headers: {'Idempotency-Key': 'key-1'}
<- 503
-> retry POST /v1/generate headers: {'Idempotency-Key': None}
```
support-bot: escalated to eng-runtime ticket INF-789 :rotating_light:
marco: noted — probable race in retry wrapper that clones request but not headers when retry strategy from threadpool hijacks RNG. assigning to @eli and @jess
eli: workaround: set SDK env REDWOOD_DISABLE_DETERMINISTIC_JITTER=1 or pin urllib3 to 1.26.15; full fix in next patch (1.4.3) will ensure idempotency header preserved and reseed jitter per-thread not per-fork.
anna: customer patched to 1.4.3-rc and confirmed no duplicates in a 30m soak. closing unless further regressions. :white_check_mark:
sam: add regression test for uWSGI+gevent+ThreadPool combination
jess: adding note to release notes and support KB with repro steps + minimal script
anna: thanks all — sending postmortem summary to acct team.
